The bag has 5 servings per 300 g, so each serving is 300 g / 5 = 60 g. Each serving has 250 calories, so the chips contain 250 cal / 60 g ≈ 4.167 cal/g.

Your daily target is 2000 calories, and you've already consumed 1800 calories, leaving 2000 - 1800 = 200 calories remaining.

You can eat 200 calories worth of chips. Since 250 calories is one 60 g serving, 200 calories is (200/250) = 0.8 servings. 0.8 servings × 60 g = 48 g.

Answer: 48
